summary.text: Bob Heaton is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 46, assumed office on November 3, 2010, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists James Pittsford III (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Bob Heaton earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana State University in 1980, and his professional experience includes working in the life insurance industry.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists Heaton on the Financial Institutions and Insurance and Ways and Means committees.
